user.title: Connect to the mixer
user.description: Enter the network details for your Midas mixer. You will define the outputs and inputs in the next steps.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the mixer.
data_description.port: The OSC port the mixer listens on (10023 for M32/X32).
data_description.local_port: Local UDP port this integration binds to receive replies. Must be unique per mixer.

output.title: Add an output
output.description: An output is a destination you mix towards — typically a room or zone. It needs a DCA fader for its overall volume and a mix bus that sources are sent to. Outputs defined so far: {count}.

data_description.label: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. "Space".
data_description.dca: The DCA group controlling this output's overall level (1-16).
data_description.bus: The mix bus sources are sent to (1-16). For stereo bus pairs this is the odd-numbered bus.
data_description.add_another: Tick to add another output after saving this one.

input.title: Add an input
input.description: An input is a source you route to your outputs. Leave the right channel empty for a mono source. A send entity is created for every input/output combination. Inputs defined so far: {count}.

data_description.label: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. "PC".
data_description.ch_l: Input channel on the mixer (1-32). For a mono source, the only channel.
data_description.ch_r: Right channel of a stereo pair (1-32). Leave empty for a mono source.
data_description.default: Starting level (0.0-1.0) for this input's sends, until the mixer reports its real value.
data_description.add_another: Tick to add another input after saving this one.

error.duplicate_label: Another entry already uses this name. Pick a different one.

abort.already_configured: A mixer is already configured on this host and local port.

init.title: Configure Midas
init.description: Change the connection details or edit the outputs and inputs. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the mixer.
data_description.port: The OSC port the mixer listens on (10023 for M32/X32).
data_description.local_port: Local UDP port this integration binds to receive replies.

add_output.title: Add an output
add_output.description: An output is a destination you mix towards — typically a room or zone.

data_description.dca: The DCA group controlling this output's overall level (1-16).
data_description.bus: The mix bus sources are sent to (1-16).

add_input.title: Add an input
add_input.description: An input is a source you route to your outputs. Leave the right channel empty for a mono source.

data_description.ch_r: Right channel of a stereo pair. Leave empty for a mono source.
data_description.default: Starting level (0.0-1.0) for this input's sends.

remove_output.title: Remove outputs
remove_output.description: Select the outputs to remove. Their fader and all sends into them are deleted.

remove_input.title: Remove inputs
remove_input.description: Select the inputs to remove. All of their sends are deleted.

levels.title: Default output level
levels.description: The starting level for every output fader, used until the mixer reports its real value.
